description: Source code for QuicPingManager class managing ping timeouts and deadlines in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: AlarmDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling alarm callbacks within QuicPingManager.

methods.name: QuicPingManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ping manager with perspective, delegate, arena, alarm factory, and context.

methods.name: SetAlarm
methods.description: Sets the alarm based on current deadlines and conditions.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm firing, triggers appropriate timeout callbacks.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the ping manager and cancels alarms.

methods.name: UpdateDeadlines
methods.description: Updates the deadlines for keep-alive and retransmittable on wire pings based on current state.

methods.name: GetEarliestDeadline
methods.description: Returns the earliest deadline among retransmittable and keep-alive deadlines.
